summary: Frontend-only retest of hero frame-sequence scroll behavior completed on public preview. Core scrub/pixel behavior, reduced-motion opt-in flow, fallback+retry recovery, and responsive reachability passed. One performance/integration risk found: sequence fetch concurrency exceeded the specified bound under delayed-network stress. WebKit/Safari could not be executed in this environment.

integration_issues.flow: Delayed frame-sheet loading with rapid target changes
integration_issues.issue: Observed in-flight hero-sequence requests peaking above expected bound (saw 4 via request lifecycle counter; 5 in route-delay stress counter), while spec expects bounded 2 background + 1 urgent.

action_items: Investigate createFrameLoader pump/request scheduling under delayed responses and rapid target flips; enforce hard cap of 3 concurrent sheet requests.
Run the same scenarios on real WebKit/Safari CI/runner (not user-agent spoof), since this environment lacks a runnable WebKit Playwright runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: Frame rendering path itself is correct: progress checkpoints mapped exactly to expected frames 0/60/120/240 with non-black canvas hashes and correct reverse updates.
Reduced-motion behavior is implemented correctly when preference is present before page load: static poster, no sequence requests, and explicit 'Bewegung einschalten' opt-in works.
Fallback+retry logic works functionally: blocked sequence enters static fallback with 'Animation erneut laden', and retry restores animated canvas + scroll updates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://subtle-motion-8.preview.emergentagent.com in Chromium automation. Verified: no <video>, no mp4/webm requests, exact frame mapping at progress 0/0.25/0.5/1, reverse/alternating direction lands on latest target without black canvas, idle frame remains stable, reduced-motion pre-load static mode + explicit opt-in works, blocked sheet fallback and retry flow works, responsive 768/390/320 had no horizontal overflow and controls remained reachable.
rca of the issue: Likely RCA for remaining risk: during delayed-network + rapid scroll target changes, loader can schedule more simultaneous sheet fetches than intended (observed >3 in-flight). Repro: intercept /media/hero-sequence/** with ~1200ms delay, perform fast alternating wheels; monitor request/requestfinished counters for sequence URLs. Mitigation: centralize a strict semaphore/token cap across all request paths (including urgent target replacement) and cancel superseded non-target fetches earlier.
